description: Service class for managing organization attribute options, including creation, deletion, updating, assignment to users, and retrieval of options and assigned options within an organization.

classes.name: OrganizationAttributeOptionService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage organization attribute options, including CRUD operations, assignment, unassignment, and retrieval of options.

methods.name: createOrganizationAttributeOption
methods.description: Creates a new organization attribute option.

methods.name: deleteOrganizationAttributeOption
methods.description: Deletes an existing organization attribute option.

methods.name: updateOrganizationAttributeOption
methods.description: Updates an existing organization attribute option.

methods.name: getOrganizationAttributeOptions
methods.description: Retrieves attribute options for a specific organization and attribute.

methods.name: assignOrganizationAttributeOptionToUser
methods.description: Assigns an attribute option to a user within an organization, with validation.

methods.name: unassignOrganizationAttributeOptionFromUser
methods.description: Removes an attribute option assignment from a user.

methods.name: getOrganizationAttributeOptionsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves attribute options assigned to a user.

methods.name: getOrganizationAttributeAssignedOptions
methods.description: Retrieves assigned options for an organization attribute, supporting filtering by ID or slug.
